Hero MotoCorp to invest over $336 million in Andhra Pradesh

Hero MotoCorp will invest over $336 million (₹3,200 crore) in Andhra Pradesh over the next three to five years. The investment aims to strengthen its global supply chain, bolster manufacturing, and expand into new business areas, including an EV hub. A key component is the establishment of a Global Parts Centre in the Tirupati district. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Naidu laid the foundation stone for this centre.
